brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: A single hex base, with nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: One Hex base · North half (piece:0,0,0;half-n) is the only piece. No covers, caps, or other parts added. A full base has no cut face, so the half base was used because drawers sit on cut faces. check_build reports meshClash clear.

The half base offers only one drawer slot (one cut face, key 's'), and the full base offers none. Only one drawer (drawer:0#0,0#cut, classic style) was placed. Other drawer styles (slide, swing, long, longbin) use the same single slot, so no more than one drawer fits on this base.

finish.summary: The build is one North-half hex base with one drawer, and nothing else. It does not meet the five-drawer requirement: a single base exposes only one drawer position, so five would need a different arrangement (for example several cut-face bases, which would add parts beyond a single base). check_build is clear with no errors.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
